posts.title: Do you guys charge for inspections before giving an estimate?
posts.text: Hey guys, Curious how everyone handles inspections before giving a quote. For smaller jobs, a quick walkthrough is usually enough. But when a homeowner complains about cold rooms, moisture, or possible insulation problems, it can take a lot more time to figure out what's actually going on.
